text:
jordan: Quick heads-up — my flight is delayed and I won't be able to take primary at 06:00 PT as planned. I need to swap out primary for the 06:00-10:00 PT window. @priya, can you take primary? If not, @sam can you be standby secondary?

ops-bot: ALERT: Active incident INC-4289 (model-serving latency spike) — currently paging primary. Current paging policy: primary -> 2min -> secondary -> 5min -> escalation. See incident page: https://redwood-internal/incidents/INC-4289

priya: I can take primary for 06:00-10:00 PT. I'll be online 05:50 PT to do handoff checks. Quick question — do we need to change any routing or just update PagerDuty rota? :thumbsup:

jordan: thanks @priya. Two quick asks for handoff: 1) confirm you can access the private runbook and incident dashboard, 2) set pages to route to you immediately at 06:00. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff (check sections "early-morning-incident-procedures" and "model-fallbacks").

sam: I'll be secondary standby and reachable. If traffic spikes and you need an extra pair, ping me. I'll keep my phone on.

maya: I can shadow for the first 30 mins (06:00-06:30 PT) to help with any fallout from INC-4289 — will watch logs and KV cache health.

jordan: listing the minimal checklist for handoff (copying from runbook):
```
- confirm PagerDuty routing: primary=priya, secondary=sam
- verify access: incident dashboard + console + KMS
- check last 2 hours of tail latency + error rate
- enable temporary model fallback: redwood/model-alpha -> redwood/model-alpha-quant if 99th p99 > 1.2s
- record handoff in #eng-oncall and update rotation slack thread
```

priya: I have access to console + KMS + incident dash. I ran the quick latency check — 15min tail looks noisy but no errors >5% yet. I'll do the explicit route flip at 06:00 PT.

jordan: to update the PagerDuty rota we usually use the rota service or the internal swap endpoint. Posting command here so ops can replay if needed:
```
curl -X POST https://oncall.redwood/api/swap -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_API_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"from":"jordan","to":"priya","start":"2026-04-12T13:00:00Z","end":"2026-04-12T17:00:00Z"}'
```

rotation-bot: ROTATION UPDATE: Swap requested by jordan. New primary: priya (06:00-10:00 PT). Secondary: sam. Shadow: maya (06:00-06:30 PT). Pages will route to priya at start time. If priya does not acknowledge within 2 minutes of the swap, pages will follow existing escalation.

priya: acknowledged. I'll ack the rotation when I flip pages. :white_check_mark:

sam: acknowledged and on standby.

maya: will be on Zoom and Slack for the first 30. If anything looks off, I'll post snippets/logs.

jordan: thank you all — leaving notes here: INC-4289 current mitigation steps attempted: cache warm-up, temporary reduction of batch sizes on model-alpha. If things escalate, promote model-alpha-quant and enable per-token throttling on low priority routes.

ops-bot: REMINDER: When handing off, add the handoff summary to the incident page and tag the incident owner.

priya: done — handoff acknowledged and summary added to the incident page. Starting watch at 05:50 PT.

rotation-bot: CONFIRMED: Swap completed at 06:00 PT. Thread closed unless further updates needed.

sam: thanks — will step in if pages escalate. Good luck everyone.
